title: The hardest battle a warrior ever fights isn’t against an external enemy; it’s against their own need for control. 🛡️
paragraphs: The hardest battle a warrior ever fights isn’t against an external enemy; it’s against their own need for control. 🛡️

We exhaust ourselves trying to force solutions, kicking down doors that God has already locked, all while ignoring the path of peace He set right in front of us. Stop trying to "fix" what God is asking you to simply accept. Your breakthrough isn't found in your understanding; it's found in your surrender.
Drop an "AMEN" if you are choosing to trust His plan today. 🙏🏾👇🏾
📖 “Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.” — Proverbs 3:5-6
